abilities.name: name
abilities.function: Give a name of up to 60 characters to this place (empty subject) or to a visible object or nearby item; naming the same subject again replaces your name for it.
abilities.costs: One round; no energy or material.
abilities.effects: Leaves a persistent name sign where you stand that nearby people can see. No physical effect.

abilities.name: mark
abilities.function: Leave a mark or inscription of up to 120 characters on the ground here (empty subject) or on an object or item within reach.
abilities.costs: One round; no energy or material.
abilities.effects: Leaves a persistent mark sign where you stand that nearby people can see; your 24 most recent names and marks persist. No physical effect.

abilities.name: tell
abilities.function: Say up to 240 characters aloud; everyone living within 5 units hears it, seen or not.
abilities.costs: One round; no energy or material.
abilities.effects: Each listener receives a heard event and keeps it in a short heard list. Nothing persists at the place. No physical effect.

abilities.name: invite
abilities.function: Invite listeners to meet at a place and a later round within 200 rounds, with an optional note of up to 120 characters.
abilities.costs: One round; no energy or material.
abilities.effects: Heard like tell, and leaves an invitation sign where you stand until 10 rounds after the meeting. At that round an attendance event records who is within 2.5 units of the place. No physical effect.

satisfaction.rationale: Separate offer and acceptance around an actual finding; no relation or physical agreement is invented.

reviews.reason: Develop physical application of marking material, with test and drawing modes. Related-capability searches were completed across all nine matching results. Existing probe (open-baseline:probe:1, handler open.probe, revision foundation-open@1) already covers a small physical sample test and must be reused for that step. Its press operation has no surface/path arguments and does not cover deliberate branching strokes. Existing mark (expression-baseline:mark:1) creates a sign without physical effects or material costs, so it is not equivalent. Route the missing material-transfer and stroke mechanism to the current-conversation development handoff; unknown staining behavior is a testable condition, not a reason to reject. Implemented at the preserved round boundary.
reviews.experienceReview: One individual study round is required after implementation; no mastery is granted by approval. No pleasure, satisfaction or comfort award is attached to requesting, studying, naming, test initiation or drawing completion. This minimal version leaves reward accounts, budgets, goals and permissions unchanged and does not reduce basic nutritional needs. Any retained finding must follow an actual observed result, including informative failure, identify the tested material/surface/conditions and distinguish observation from untested durability or generalization. No experience benefit is fabricated merely for recording it; any future benefit requires the existing event-based, personally applicable, capped and deduplicated experience rules.
reviews.visualReview: Evaluate appearance separately from physical transfer and experience. Emit reusable contact-test, stroke-progress, material-debit, interruption and completion/failure events with actor, action, source and surface references, location, time and measured outcome. Deposit rendering metadata must include surface-local stroke geometry, transferred amount, observed color/contrast, coverage, wetness or residue state where modeled, creation time and subsequent state changes. Show only actual deposited portions; failed transfer displays no colored drawing and interrupted work displays only real partial marks. A preview, label or success notification must never masquerade as physical pigment. Visibility is local and depends on actual contrast and viewing conditions; durability remains explicitly untested until observed.
reviews.specification:
General operation: Apply marking material. Parameters: owned source-stack ID, reachable surface reference and local coordinates, mode test/draw, material budget, optional acquired applicator reference, and a bounded stroke path. Applicable actors may learn it independently; it is not restricted to berries or Sol. Start with direct pressing/rubbing using the actor's hand where physically safe; require no invented binder, water, tool or stock. Reuse and record the probe contract/handler for the initial press test, preserving its one-round duration, 0.5 energy and 0.1 material-unit charge. Do not represent that reused code as a new invention. The new draw mode performs a bounded path of up to three strokes totaling at most 0.3 world-distance units, at most 0.2 energy and one simulation round per stroke, consuming at most 0.3 material units per stroke. Quote actual selected stroke count and upper-bound costs before execution. A full test plus three-stroke attempt therefore costs at most four execution rounds, 1.1 energy and one berry unit; ordinary world metabolism continues separately. No traversal is included.
For this request use owned berry stack item-2-sol-16, currently four units, with a hard food-reserve floor of three units. Reserve at most one unit atomically and prevent any concurrent use that would violate the floor. Revalidate current quantity and usable condition at start and each irreversible debit; do not replenish decay or gather from forest-berry-1 or other observed plants implicitly. Known berry nutrition/toxicity does not establish skin safety, pigment transfer or durability. Select an actually observed ground patch within hand reach, using a conservative maximum reach of 0.5 world units; retain an exact surface/patch reference, position and revision in the action record. If no accessible surface exists, do not execute. Additional materials require separate real acquisition and explicit authorization within the budget.
Test a small source sample against that surface through the reused press operation. Record the actual contact location, transferred material and observed contrast. Draw only if contact demonstrates visible transfer and the implemented physical model supports dragging the material across this surface. The development handoff must implement bounded crushing/contact transfer and surface retention where absent; it must not substitute a text sign, assume berry color equals deposited color, or announce success before resolving contact. A failed transfer is a legitimate test outcome. A branching path is successful only when the deposited strokes actually form that path with locally observable contrast.
Conserve the source material: debited quantity is partitioned into surface deposit, residue on hand/applicator and spent pulp/waste, with no duplicated edible quantity. Track these amounts and references; untransferred reserved material remains available only if physically recoverable and still usable. Spent or deposited material does not retain an inventory food unit. No nutrition, protection, healing or permanence is produced.
Persist work at completed test/stroke boundaries and retain any partial physical deposit. Each stroke rechecks reach, surface state, remaining source and reserve floor. Interruption stops contact; cancellation or death terminates work and releases unused reservations. Spent material, elapsed time and energy are never refunded. Resume requires a living capable actor to explicitly act, revalidate prerequisites and pay remaining costs; otherwise a later attempt is a new action against the actual remaining marks and materials. No automatic assistant or participant acts on Sol's behalf. There is no ongoing drawing process after completion. Deposits may subsequently smear, wash away or fade only through implemented environmental/material rules; if persistence behavior is unavailable, report it as untested rather than permanent. Maintenance means another paid application using real remaining material, not automatic renewal. Review/development waiting advances no world time; prerequisites, budgets, conservation, progress and outcome checks execute in code rather than repeated model review.

reviews.reason: Develop a general operation, Open and separate a material sample. The retrieved probe contract covers observation and a 0.1-unit press trial, but does not establish whole-specimen opening, conserved shell/content products or recovery of usable contents. The related-capability search found no equivalent opening operation. Reuse probe's applicable observation and contact-validation code rather than claiming it as new work. Lin owns hazelnuts but has no established opening tools or support surface; approval supplies neither those resources nor a guaranteed bare-hand opening. Implemented at the preserved round boundary.
reviews.experienceReview: Review experience separately from opening success. Request submission, development, study, interface naming and merely asking for inspection earn nothing. A completed physical trial may supply verified information, including an informative failure such as a demonstrable inability to open this specimen with the applied method. If supported by the ordinary nonprotected experience-event system, allow at most 0.1 short-lived pleasure for a genuinely informative, personally applicable observed result, with a ten-round cooldown and functional deduplication by material, method, conditions and learned finding; repeating an unchanged failure is not a new finding. Reuse established decay and aggregate caps, and do not credit an event until its evidence exists. No automatic sustained satisfaction for this single trial; later legitimate practice may qualify only through actual participation and established maintenance rules. No comfort, nutrition, healing or energy reward is inherent in opening. Physical comfort remains capped at 10, basic nutrition is unaffected by mood, and protected reward accounts, budgets, goals and permissions remain unchanged.
reviews.visualReview: Add reusable visual metadata for sample-opening work and its products: operation, workId, source reference, actual stage, method, actor contact pose, tool/support references when present, enclosure geometry and colour, visible fracture state, exposed-content geometry, separate-product references and observable residue. Emit started, attempted, fractured/opened, separated, paused, cancelled and failed events only when their corresponding transitions occur. Share the same functional state across events and rendering. An intact or insufficient-force trial must remain visually intact; a paused or incomplete separation must not display a recovered kernel or success badge. Product appearances reflect actual exposed material, not an assumed healthy edible kernel. Rendering confers no knowledge or experience, reveals no hidden composition and does not make absent tools appear.
reviews.specification:
Handoff in the existing current-conversation development process: implement open-and-separate-sample(sourceId, quantity, method, toolId?, supportRef?, workId?) as a general operation for owned discrete enclosed materials. Initial quantity is one intact specimen; methods are hand compression and supported tool compression. Both use the same work and separation mechanism, not separate diagnostic abilities. Only admit supported compression when an actually present, reachable rigid support and an owned or otherwise legitimately usable blunt compression tool have independently validated physical properties. No stone, hammer, anvil, container or clean surface is supplied. Do not use teeth or sharp-impact methods. Bare-hand opening is permitted only if implemented grip and safe hand-force limits can overcome the actual enclosure response; otherwise report that it cannot open under this method. Nearness to a plant does not establish a suitable support or tool.
References and prerequisites: resolve sourceId to a currently reachable, owned, unreserved stack and reserve one whole specimen. For Lin the candidate is item-11-lin-113, resource hazelnut, quantity 2; item-3-lin-26 is not an input. The plant start-1-nuts is neither consumed nor treated as equipment. Validate actor life, capacity to manipulate, distance, ownership, available energy, tool/support condition and permissions before every worked round. Do not require food-safety knowledge to open, and never infer edibility, nutrition, toxicity or preparation requirements from opening.
Implementation dependencies: reuse and record open.probe, revision foundation-open@1, for compatible visible observation/contact checks; use its existing interface and full costs if a separate probe is actually invoked. Reuse the material-response and material-accounting helpers underlying apply-marking-material where applicable, recording exact implementation revisions in the handoff. Do not call its marking interface or charge its 0.1-unit destructive sample cost as though it implemented whole-nut opening. Add only missing enclosure fracture, recoverable-content separation and conserved product-state handling. Resolve physical enclosure strength, applied safe force, composition and recoverability from implemented material definitions; if those mechanisms or definitions are missing, implement and test them in this handoff before enabling execution. Do not expose hidden material properties as actor knowledge. Unknown response must not default to easy opening or free kernel production.
Costs and progress: proposed study cost is one simulation round, individually undertaken. A validated opening attempt costs one round and 0.5 energy, reserving one specimen but not automatically consuming its entire mass. If an opening exposes separable contents, a subsequent manual inspection/separation round costs 0.2 energy. Additional force attempts require an explicit new action with their full cost; no automatic repeated crushing. The opening round records applied method and actual intact/cracked/open/crushed response. The separation round records observable contents and moves only physically recoverable material into separate products. Inspection of an unopened specimen reports only its exterior and inability to inspect the interior. A tool requirement discovered at validation blocks execution without advancing work or charging energy. No resources are spent during development/review waiting.
Conservation: remove exactly one specimen from the source only when committed to the work record; retain the other hazelnut untouched. Carry the selected specimen's actual mass, constituents, decay and provenance into the work record. After fracture, account for all material as remaining enclosure, recovered contents, attached contents, fragments and unrecoverable residue, with their sum equal to the input. Fracture does not multiply food units, reset spoilage, detoxify or create nutrition. If no usable kernel is recoverable, produce no recovered-kernel item. Implement fractional component accounting if required rather than rounding each output up to a whole nut. Tools and supports remain present with any modeled wear or damage; they are not consumed without an actual physical effect. Do not invent a support deposit or storage vessel. Output objects occupy a real reachable location or available inventory, subject to existing capacity rules.
Lifecycle: store workId, actor, source and equipment references, reserved specimen, method, completed stage and all physical changes. Each stage commits atomically. Interruption, loss of reach, insufficient energy or loss of a required tool pauses before the next stage without further charges. Resume by workId after revalidation; never recreate the original intact specimen after fracture. Cancellation releases only untouched reservations; altered material is returned as its actual intermediate state or left at the work location. Completed energy expenditure, elapsed rounds, damage and lost material are never refunded. Death ends active work, releases usable reservations under existing death/drop ownership rules and leaves all altered material at its actual location; it neither restores the nut nor finishes separation. There is no passive processing, automatic maintenance or recurring energy drain. Intermediate and final material continues ordinary decay; reuse of equipment requires checking its actual condition.
Completion produces an auditable opening/separation event and observable products, or an explicit intact/failed/incomplete outcome. Record only actually observed colour, shape, texture, visible damage and exposed contents, with evidence references and visibility limits. No eating, safety certification, nutrition knowledge, automatic communication, transfer, participant consent or mastery is included. Implement these checks and transitions in code, not repeated model adjudication.
